svg.aria-label: VNet flow logs and traffic analytics in four bands: the raw flow tuple and its states, the eight encryption statuses and which ones mean the packet was dropped, the second aggregation traffic analytics performs and why the portal and Log Analytics disagree, and the constraints plus the NSG flow log retirement deadline.
svg.title: Two aggregations between the packet and the dashboard, and the counts do not match on purpose
svg.text: The packet is aggregated twice before you see it
Once into a one-minute flow tuple, then again into a single Log Analytics row. Each step throws something away.
1 · THE RAW RECORD — LAYER 4, ONE-MINUTE BLOBS, JSON
Tuple (v2)
time, src IP, dst IP, src port, dst port, protocol, direction, state, encryption,
packets sent, bytes sent, packets received, bytes received
v5 adds
PLS Link Identifier · Source NAT IP · Source NAT Port — three regions only
State
B begin · C continuing · E end · D deny
Direction
I inbound · O outbound
Counts on C and E records are aggregates SINCE THE PREVIOUS TUPLE — so you add them, you do not take the last one.
Documented example: 1,021 + 52 + 8,005 + 47 = 9,125 packets, and 5,256,000 bytes across one conversation.
2 · EIGHT ENCRYPTION STATUSES, AND THREE MEAN “DROPPED”
X
Encrypted, as configured
NX
Unencrypted — and this is the DEFAULT for every VNet
NX_LOCAL_DST
Same Azure host — unencrypted by design, not a fault
NX_FALLBACK
Allowed, but unencrypted — encryption was attempted and failed
NX_SW_NOT_READY
Packet dropped — host stack not ready after a boot or update
NX_NOT_ACCEPTED
Packet dropped — drop-on-unencrypted policy, encryption failed
NX_NOT_SUPPORTED
Packet dropped — host stack cannot do discovery. Report it.
NX_HW_NOT_SUPPORTED
FPGA missing or faulty on the host. Report it.
3 · TRAFFIC ANALYTICS AGGREGATES A SECOND TIME
Collapses on
src IP + dst IP + dst port + NSG name + NSG rule + direction + protocol
Excludes
SOURCE PORT — so you cannot count connections from a Log Analytics row
Interval
60 minutes by default, or 10 minutes · ingestion can add up to 1 hour
Table
NTANetAnalytics, schema 3 — replaces AzureNetworkAnalytics_CL
100 conversations in an hour become ONE row. The portal shows the total it saw; Log Analytics shows the reduced record.
They are both right. When you need the individual flows, follow blob_id back to storage.
4 · WHERE THE RECORD IS SIMPLY NOT THERE
ExpressRoute
VM→circuit egress is not logged at the gateway subnet. FastPath bypasses it entirely.
PaaS
Twelve services unsupported: Functions, Logic Apps, App Service, ACI, Container Apps…
Storage
Same region, Standard only. Rotate the CMK and logging stops until you re-enable it.
Cost
5 GB/month free per subscription for the logs. Traffic analytics has no free tier.
NSG flow logs retire 30 September 2027. New ones already cannot be created, and the resources get deleted.
Disable NSG flow logs before enabling VNet flow logs on the same workloads, or you pay to record the same traffic twice.
